text: What does an ideal campaign look like? Big reach, small cost, real impact. We did it in Saudi Arabia with zero production costs. This summer, we faced a challenge: launching a campaign in a new market. So we looked beyond numbers, charts, and insights to find what truly matters: the voice your audience wants to hear. And then it clicked. We don't need to shape that voice. People already trust real ones. So instead of filming TV-like commercials, we handed the camera to the community and empowered real voices. Together with Saudi creators, we turned our message, your ride, your price, into stories that spoke their language, their humor, their streets, their life. We focused on in-feed ads and native UGC formats using TikTok One, a creator marketplace connecting brands with local creators. Here's how it works. We defined our message, then invited Saudi creators to make it their own. They filmed, edited, and brought us stories that looked and felt native to TikTok. Real people, real culture, real moments. Within one week, we received ten unique UGC videos, six times faster than any traditional agency production. A campaign created by the community for the community. TikTok One creatives generated seventy-five percent of all installs on TikTok. ROAS was sixty-two percent higher compared to other creative formats in the same campaign. CPI was seventy-seven percent lower, and CPA was seventy-three percent lower than the overall creative average. CTR improved by eighty-seven percent and VTR by sixty-five percent, proving stronger engagement and retention. TikTok One creatives accounted for eighty-two percent of all views and eighty percent of all clicks. The campaign gave local Saudi creators a voice that truly represented the brand. This people-driven campaign proved that creativity can outperform budget, powered by real voices through TikTok One.
